[b]Deployment of the Nordstern Gruppe and the Hochdeutsche Navy to Tallisland [/b]

[i]A force of around 10,000 Nordstern Gruppe fighters via C-17 have been flown into Tallisland. Constant sealift operations from their base of operations in the southern Republik have allowed the delivery of fuel, small arms, ammunition and others as they are employed in the fight against socialist forces within the country. Acting as an airborne assault group the Nordstern Gruppe will act as a rapid response force against socialist insurgent activity. Advanced weapons systems have also been brought by amphibious ready groups into Tallisland including the NMESIS anti-ship system which employs the naval strike missile as well as HIMARS armed with the PrSM anti-ship ramjet ballistic missile. LTAMDS 360 degree enabled radar systems are also in the process of being deployed to Tallisland to help protect against possible missile and aerial attacks. The Republik has also begun supplying the J-35s and their collaborative UAVs in the country with the 500-lb variant of the QUICKSINK JDAM and next-generation Golden Horde AI-enabled swarm cruise missiles. 

The Hochdeutsche Navy has also been mobilized to block off malicious foreign access to Tallisland waters. C-17s armed with PDs have been regularly seeding Tallisland waters with propulsion disablers to give the EDU the ability to shut down illegal foreign military aid to socialist forces. Sea Shark 800 USVs and Manta Ray UUVs have also been seen off of Tallisland waters. [/i]
